concepts.gloss_en: The act of seeking/asking 'where is the place of His glory' — a person's searching, not the phrase itself

members.note: same act of seeking the place of His glory; 'begins to seek' vs 'asks and searches' are paraphrases of one action in the same passage

concepts.gloss_en: The liturgical question 'where is the place of His glory' (from the Kedushah) itself — the object, not the act of seeking it

members.note: the bare phrase/object; per rule 4 the act of seeking X is not X

notes: The two 'כש...' forms name the act of searching for the divine glory; the bare 'איה מקום כבודו' is the quoted liturgical phrase that is the object of that search — kept separate per the action-vs-object rule.
